as_told.title: Epstein's Zorro Ranch near retired Los Alamos physicists

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that Jeffrey Epstein, the wealthy financier, told political strategist Steve Bannon in an interview near the end of his life why he set up Zorro Ranch in New Mexico. According to Michels, Epstein said he picked the spot to be near retiring physicists from Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory. The story dates the ranch to 1993, though one of Michels's tellings gives no year. Michels uses it to argue that security at the DOE, the Department of Energy that runs the nuclear labs, is so lax that an outsider could get close to its scientists.
